_meta.units: Distances in metres, speeds in m/s, accelerations in m/s^2, angles in degrees, times in ms unless the key ends in Seconds. Damage and health are HP points. Keys that start with an underscore are documentation and code should ignore them.
_meta.spec: docs/design/GDD.md, docs/design/systems/*.md (M2a: combat.md, armor.md, stance.md, grenades.md, loot.md; M2b: maps.md, drop.md, rooms.md, camera.md; M2c: levels.md, melee.md, rpg.md, smoke.md, layout.md)
_meta._m2cPendingNote: M2c: every new key and every changed loot weight is staged in the top-level _m2cPending block, because the current validateBalance (src/shared/balance.ts) rejects the new ids in loot.tiers / bots.weaponPrefs / clientFeel.fpRecoil and allows sight 'none' only on fists. No live key changed in v4. Tech-lead: when the M2c types land, deep-merge _m2cPending into the root (objects key by key, arrays replace), then delete it. L1 level multipliers are exactly 1, so every live weapon number stays the L1 value and existing tests stay valid.
_meta._m2aRemoved: M2a removed player.maxArmor, items.vest and the armor.absorbFraction key. Armor is now per piece: items.vest_1..3 and items.helmet_1..3 {slot, tier, durability, absorbFraction}. See systems/armor.md.
_meta._m2bRemoved: M2b removed clientFeel.fpFovDefault, fpFovMin, fpFovMax and fpFovReferenceAspect. The FOV setting range is FP_FOV_MIN_DEG / FP_FOV_MAX_DEG / DEFAULT_FP_FOV_DEG / FP_FOV_REFERENCE_ASPECT in src/shared/contracts.ts (ADR 0005 section 9).
_meta._mapsNote: M2b (systems/maps.md section 3, ADR 0005 section 4): maps.<mapId> holds per-map overrides, deep-merged over the base sections for every match on that map (balanceForMap). Objects merge key by key; arrays (zone.phases) and scalars replace wholesale. Only keys that differ from the base. zoneTheme is a required per-map key, not an override. Forbidden per map: net, maps, rooms, match.maxPlayers, match.minHumansToStart, match.countdownSeconds, match.mapVoteLockSeconds. Base sections = the island.

match._mapVoteNote: M2b (maps.md 1.3, rooms.md): the map vote locks, and the map and carrier route are resolved, mapVoteLockSeconds before the countdown ends. Lobby-time key, not overridable per map. minHumansToStart is superseded inside rooms by rooms.minHumansToStartWith(out)Bots.

player._note: height, eyeHeight and headZoneFraction are the STANDING values and must equal movement.stances.stand.height / eyeHeight. Crouch and prone hitboxes: combat.hitbox and movement.stances.

stances._note: systems/stance.md. height = hitbox and collision height (feet to top); eyeHeight = shot origin, line of sight and camera pivot. Ground speed = base speed x speedMultiplier (x ADS, heal, water and fire multipliers; see stance.md 'Speed formula'). transitionMs keys are '<from>_<to>'. During a transition: speed uses the lower speedMultiplier of the two stances, the hitbox and collision height use the taller stance, eyeHeight lerps linearly. Water depth = max(0, -terrainHeight) at the feet. M2b: pronePitchMinDeg/MaxDeg clamp the SIM pitch while the stance is prone or a transition has prone at either end (systems/camera.md); stand and crouch keep PITCH_MIN/MAX.
stances._bug008: BUG-008 (stance.md 'Visual fit'): prone.height 0.5 -> 0.6 so a chibi head centred on the prone eye (0.35) fits the box with the same ~0.1 m overhang as standing (1.39 vs 1.30). Crouch stays 0.95 (office low cover: boxSmall 0.99 hides a crouched player). The poses move to the sim, not the reverse.

drop._note: M2b carrier drop (systems/drop.md). Base values = island; office overrides go in maps.office.drop (systems/maps.md). Altitude is absolute y. Freefall uses freefallSpeed/freefallSteerSpeed; the parachute phase uses movement.dropFallSpeed/dropSteerSpeed. chuteDeployHeight is measured above the terrain/floor below (props ignored). Route: heading uniform 0-360, lateral offset uniform within +-routeLateralFraction x support(normal); entry/exit where the line meets the play area expanded by routeEntryMargin; eject where it leaves the play area inset by ejectInset; redraw up to routeMaxTries until the jump window >= minJumpWindowMetres. match.dropHeight is no longer used for the match start.

combat._spreadNote: Cone half-angle = spreadDeg x A x S x M x J. A = 1 + (adsSpreadMultiplier - 1) x adsProgress. S = stanceSpreadMultiplier[stance] when the stance is settled, 1 during a transition. M = moveSpreadMultiplier when horizontal speed > moveSpreadSpeedThreshold. J = airSpreadMultiplier when airborne. No clamps. combat.md 'Spread'.

hitbox._note: Stand: vertical cylinder radius player.radius, height stances.stand.height, head = top player.headZoneFraction. Crouch: same cylinder with height stances.crouch.height, head = top crouchHeadZoneFraction. Prone: level box centred on the feet (x, z), long axis along the look yaw, proneLength x proneWidth x stances.prone.height; head = the front proneHeadLength metres (toward the look direction). During a transition: the cylinder of the taller stance.

weapons._note: sight: none | iron | red_dot | scope_4x | scope_8x. adsZoom divides clientFeel.cameraFovDeg at full ADS. adsSpreadMultiplier is the A term at adsProgress 1. adsMoveMultiplier scales ground speed while ADS is engaged. adsTimeMs = time from 0 to full ADS (exit is instant). fireMoveMultiplier scales ground speed for combat.fireMoveWindowMs after each shot (LMG only, 1 elsewhere). Shots-to-kill tables: combat.md.

rifle._m2aNote: Nerfed (M1 rifle took most kills): damage 22 -> 19, headshotMultiplier 1.75 -> 1.8 (keeps 3 headshots = 102.6), hip spreadDeg 1.0 -> 1.6 (needs ADS for range), falloff 40/110/0.7 -> 30/90/0.65. Loot weights cut too.

lmg._note: Planted suppression gun: highest sustained DPS and a 60 round mag, but wide hip spread, the worst moving spread, a 5 s reload, slow ADS, and fireMoveMultiplier 0.55 while firing. Best prone (spread x 0.6).

dmr._note: Semi-auto marksman rifle. Poor hip fire (3.0 deg), pin-point scoped (0.3 deg). 3 body / 2 head (head + body also kills).

sniper._note: Bolt-action: fireIntervalMs (1400) IS the bolt cycle; the scope stays up while the bolt cycles. No falloff (falloffStart = falloffEnd = range, minDamageFactor 1) so the one-shot rules hold at every range. Body 80 never kills a full-HP player; head 160 kills through helmet_1 and helmet_2, not through a helmet_3 above 60 durability. Arithmetic in combat.md.

items._armorNote: systems/armor.md. Per hit on the covered zone: a = min(durability, dmg x absorbFraction); durability -= a; hp -= dmg - a. A piece at 0 durability is destroyed (tier 0). Design invariant (keeps 'effective HP = 100 + durability'): durability < 100 x absorbFraction / (1 - absorbFraction). Vest covers body hits and grenades; helmet covers head hits only.

grenade._note: systems/grenades.md. Throw speed = lerp(throwSpeedMin, throwSpeedMax, t), t = clamp((pitchDeg - throwPitchMinDeg) / (throwPitchMaxDeg - throwPitchMinDeg), 0, 1), x throwSpeedProneMultiplier when settled prone. Launch pitch = aim pitch + throwLiftDeg (max 89). radius is the BLAST radius; collisionRadius is the physics radius. dangerMargin: the HUD danger indicator shows live grenades within radius + dangerMargin metres of the local player (client only). Damage at 3D distance d from the blast to the target's chest: maxDamage if d <= innerRadius, else lerp(1, minDamageFactor, (d - innerRadius) / (radius - innerRadius)) x maxDamage, 0 beyond radius. No armTime: frags only explode on fuse.

armor._note: General armor rules (per-piece numbers live in items.vest_N / items.helmet_N). dropOnDeath: worn pieces with durability > 0 drop as pickups on death with their remaining durability.

loot._tiersNote: M2a weights. Rifle cut (common 3 -> 2, rare 14 -> 9, epic 30 -> 14). lmg rare-heavy, dmr rare/epic, sniper almost only epic, tier-3 armor epic only, grenades in every tier. Expected per 70-spawn match: rifle 2.7 (M1 4.7), lmg 1.2, dmr 1.2, sniper 0.6, vest_1 2.6, vest_2 1.4, vest_3 0.5, helmet_1 2.1, helmet_2 1.2, helmet_3 0.4, grenade stacks 2.9 (5.8 grenades). Arithmetic in loot.md.

zone._phasesNote: M1-fix pacing: long, roomy middle phases (P2/P3 hold 65 m and 47.5 m, about 30 m between survivors) so fights spread over the match; short, tight late phases (P5/P6) so the endgame resolves quickly. Every shrink ends at 2:00 / 3:45 / 5:20 / 6:30 / 7:20 / 8:00, collapse closes at 8:40. Reasoning in systems/zone.md.
zone._indoorNote: M2b (maps.md 2.2): on indoor maps every zone centre must lie inside the floor rectangle inset by indoorCenterInset metres (replaces the island land check; fallback 50% toward (0, 0)). Island maps ignore it.

bots.difficultyNote: Bots aim at chest height (not heads), need reactionMs after first sighting before shooting, and fire in bursts with pauses. A human who strafes and lands headshots should win most 1v1s; a standing-still human loses. If playtests show bots too strong, raise aimErrorDeg/reactionMs first; if too weak, lower burstPauseMs. Pacing (how soon bots pick fights) is set by the loot phase and eagerness keys below, not by aim.
bots._pacingNote: M1-fix pacing (GDD 10). Loot phase: for lootPhaseSeconds x personality.lootPhaseMultiplier after landing a bot only fights enemies within lootPhaseEngageRange or who shot it in the last retaliateMs, and skips loot within avoidRange of a visible enemy. Eagerness then ramps 0 -> 1 over eagernessRampSeconds (raised to eagernessCurve), with a floor of zonePhaseIndex / eagernessFullAtPhase; engagement range = lerp(lootPhaseEngageRange, max(fire range, minEngageRange), eagerness) x personality.engageRangeMultiplier, capped by visionRange (ads.scopedVisionRange while the bot carries a usable scope_4x/scope_8x gun).

drop._note: M2b bot jump choice (systems/drop.md 'Bots: jump choice'). Candidates = loot spawns within auto-deploy reach x reachSafetyFraction of the in-window route; weight tierWeights[tier] (x personality dropEpicWeightMultiplier for epic); skip a candidate once maxBotsPerTarget earlier picks lie within bots.dropSpreadRange of it (a pick of the same spawn counts, distance 0). Jump when the carrier passes the closest route point + personality jumpTimingBiasMs + uniform +-jumpJitterMs, clamped to the window.

nav._note: M2b indoor navigation (systems/maps.md section 4). Island maps ignore it (M1 steering). Grid of cellSize cells on the floor and every walkable top, built once per map id, deterministic. A* costs in metres; climb links cost route length x climbCostMultiplier; drop-down links cost dropCost. Path cache of pathCacheSize entries keyed by (start cell, goal cell). At most maxPathsPerTick new searches per tick across all bots. Replan on goal change, when stuck, or every replanMs. Cautious bots pick a plateau hold point inside the next circle with probability plateauHoldChance.

weaponPrefs._note: M2a bot weapon choice (GDD 10, combat.md 'Bots'). In a fight at distance d the bot holds a usable gun whose [minRange, maxRange] contains d (highest lootValue wins ties); if none does, the gun with the best expectedBodyDps(d). Loot upgrades compare lootValue: replace the lower-value carried gun when new lootValue > old lootValue x bots.ai.gunUpgradeFactor.

ads._note: Bots hold ADS while firing when the held gun's sight is scope_4x/scope_8x, or its sight is red_dot/iron and the target is farther than minRange. While ADS, bot aim error x aimErrorMultiplier. A bot carrying a usable scoped gun sees up to scopedVisionRange instead of visionRange. A bot holding a scoped gun fires only at adsProgress >= scopedFireMinProgress (ADR 0004 A1.6), so it never hip-fires a scoped gun.

stance._note: At each strafe change while engaged at distance >= minRange and holding a non-iron-sight gun, roll personality.stanceChance. Success: stop strafing and crouch (or prone with probability proneShare, when water depth allows) for holdMs, then stand. Leave early when hit by an unseen attacker, the target is lost, or the tide is urgent.

grenade._note: Each decision tick, a bot carrying grenades whose engaged target was last seen within coverMemoryMs but is not visible now, at last-known distance in [minRange, maxRange], throws with probability throwChancePerDecision x personality.grenadeChanceMultiplier (at most once per cooldownMs). It cooks cookMs, aims at the last-known position plus a random offset of up to aimErrorMetres, throws, then swaps back. Any bot that can see a live grenade within fleeRadius runs directly away from it.

ai._note: Loot desirability scores are relative and divided by (1 + distance / lootDistanceFalloff). Armor value = (lootScoreVest or lootScoreHelmet) + lootScoreArmorPerTier x tier, only if the pickup would be accepted (armor.md). Steering keys (turn rates in deg/s, zoneUrgencyBufferSeconds) are omitted so the BOT_AI defaults in src/shared/sim/bots.ts apply.

clientFeel._note: Client presentation only, never sim rules (consumer: src/game/tuning.ts). Distances in m, angles in degrees, times in ms. M2b: the on-foot, freefall, parachute and spectate camera is FIRST PERSON (systems/camera.md); fp* = first-person camera, vm* = viewmodel, fpRecoil.<weaponId> = visual-only recoil. Third-person keys cameraDistance, cameraShoulderOffset (< 0.6), cameraFovDeg (vertical) and orbit* now apply ONLY to the 3P cases (aboard orbit, death cam, V chase spectate, results).
clientFeel._carrierNote: M2b: carrierCameraDistance = the 3P orbit distance (m) from the carrier while aboard (CameraView view 'carrier', ADR 0005 section 8). Base 26 frames the seaplane (22.6 m wingspan) at cameraFovDeg 70; maps.office.clientFeel overrides it to 10 for the 7.7 m drone under the 27 m ceiling. The client must resolve tuning from the per-map balance (mapChanged.balance).

fpRecoil._note: Visual only (camera.md 'Recoil'): viewmodel kickBack (m) and kickPitchDeg, camera rollDeg and fovPunchDeg, all back to rest within returnMs. Never rotates camera pitch/yaw. Automatic fire stacks to at most 2x.

rooms._note: M2b room rules (systems/rooms.md, ADR 0006). Countdown length stays match.countdownSeconds; the map lock is match.mapVoteLockSeconds. Ops limits (MAX_ROOMS, rate limits, list throttle) are server config, not balance. Not overridable per map. Rules: 1 <= minMaxHumans <= defaultMaxHumans <= maxMaxHumans <= match.maxPlayers; minHumansToStartWithoutBots >= 2. kickRejoinBlockSeconds: a kicked player cannot rejoin that room for this long.

office._note: Toy-scale (x9) indoor office (systems/maps.md sections 2-3, systems/drop.md, levels/office.md). drop: toy delivery drone under the 27 m ceiling, short napkin parachute (lands about 2.25 s after the jump, 21 m reach). carrierSpeed 12 -> 15 (Phase C matchReport: median landing 10.9-11.6 s vs the drop.md AT13 target <= 10 s; next lever noJumpMs 1500 -> 1000). movement.fallDamageMinSpeed 18: a 6.7 m desk walk-off or jump-off is safe (safe height 8.1 m). zone: startRadius 140 covers the 234 x 144 m floor (half-diagonal 137.4); same schedule as the island, phase radii 95 / 70 / 50 / 30 / 15 / 5 m. bots: shorter sight down the long aisle, hearing muffled by walls, smaller avoidRange so bots still loot small rooms. loot: more grenades and shotguns, fewer snipers. clientFeel: closer carrier orbit for the small drone.

_m2cPending._note: M2c design, NOT LIVE (see _meta._m2cPendingNote). Paths mirror their final location in the root. Specs: systems/levels.md, melee.md, rpg.md, smoke.md, layout.md, combat.md, loot.md, armor.md, grenades.md.

combat._throwableNote: grenades.md 'Throwable slot': pressing 4/G while the throwable slot is already held and ready cycles to the next carried type; the cycle takes throwableCycleMs (no fire, no throw). Selecting the slot from another slot still costs combat.swapMs.

levels._note: systems/levels.md. Every weapon except fists has a level 1-4 (ItemLevel). Effective stat = weapons.<id>.<field> x multiplier[level - 1]. Each array has 4 entries; index 0 (L1) must be exactly 1, and every entry must be in [0.5, 2]. Per field the multiplier comes from overrides.<id>.<field> if present, else the class default (gun = every weapon with ammo != null, melee = knife/machete/paddle) if present, else 1. Scalable fields: damage (for the rpg it also scales rocket.blast.maxDamage), reloadMs, fireIntervalMs (for melee it also scales hitFrameMs), spreadDeg. No rounding; the 30 Hz tick quantises times. lootTiers.<tier> = relative weights of L1..L4 for any weapon rolled at a loot spot of that tier (armor is not rolled: its level is the id suffix). botValueMultiplier: bots multiply a weapon's lootValue by this for its level.

overrides._note: shotgun: damage flat so 9 pellets (99) never one-shot a full-HP body; levels tighten the cone and the pump instead. dmr: damage capped at x1.15 so an L4 body pair (96.6) never kills a full-HP player; the bolt/trigger gets faster instead. sniper: x1.2 keeps an L4 body shot (96) below 100 and an L4 head (192) below a fresh helmet_4 kill (92 HP loss). rpg: x1.15 so an L4 direct hit (172.5) still leaves a fresh vest_3 alive.

weapons._meleeNote: systems/melee.md. Melee entries (MeleeId: knife, machete, paddle) keep the WeaponBalance shape. fireIntervalMs IS the swing cycle (click to next swing); range IS the reach (m, from the eye along the aim); hitFrameMs = time from the click to the single hit check; sweepRadius = capsule radius around the aim segment; knockbackSpeed (m/s, horizontal, along the attacker's yaw) and knockbackLift (m/s up, not applied to prone targets) are added to the target's velocity on a hit. falloffStart = falloffEnd = range and minDamageFactor 1 = no falloff. sight none, no ammo, no ADS. They live in slot 2 (the fists slot) and never take a gun slot.
weapons._rpgNote: systems/rpg.md. weapons.rpg.damage IS the direct-hit impact damage (body zone, vest absorbs); range IS the rocket's max travel distance (it air-bursts there). rocket.* = projectile and blast. Blast uses the grenade blast model (grenades.md 'Explosion') with rocket.blast.*; blast maxDamage scales with the level damage multiplier. A rocket that hits anything before travelling armDistance metres is a dud: impact damage only, no blast.

revolver._note: Heavy pistol: 3 body / 2 head unarmored, 6 rounds of ammo_heavy, slow trigger. The skill sidearm of the common pool.

dbshotgun._note: Double barrel: 10 pellets x 12 = 120 at point blank (one-shots an unarmored body; both barrels kill any armor within ~3 m in 0.25 s). Very wide cone and steep falloff: about 15 damage per barrel at 8 m. 2 shells, slow reload. One barrel per click.

smoke._note: systems/smoke.md. Same throw formula, flight physics and bounce rules as items.grenade (grenades.md), with these values. cookable false: the fuse starts at release and nothing is consumed until release. At fuse end the canister is removed and a cloud is created. Cloud = a sphere centred centerHeight above the deploy point (water: above y = 0). Opaque radius r(t), t = ms since deploy: t < growMs: radius x t / growMs; t < growMs + holdMs: radius; t < growMs + holdMs + fadeMs: radius x (1 - (t - growMs - holdMs) / fadeMs); then removed. closeSightRange: two points closer than this see each other through smoke (bots, name tags). maxActive: at most this many clouds; a new one makes the oldest start its fade at once.

loot._tiersNote: M2c full tables (replace loot.tiers.* wholesale). Every M2b id keeps an entry. New: revolver, dbshotgun, rpg, knife, machete, paddle, smoke, vest_4, helmet_4, ammo_rocket. Sums: common 102, rare 104, epic 103. Expected counts per map in loot.md 'M2c expected items per match'. Weapon levels are rolled from levels.lootTiers.

layout._note: systems/layout.md (gameplay side of per-match layout variety; level-designer owns candidates, groups and arrangements). lootUsedPerTier = loot points activated per match per tier (each then rolls loot.spawnChance); the sum of MapData loot-group use counts must equal it (data test). lootCandidateFactorMin: every loot group has at least ceil(use x factor) candidates and at least use + 1. minLootSpacing: metres between any two activated loot points. minCoverFraction: every arrangement of a POI or desk zone keeps at least this fraction of the largest arrangement's blocking collider footprint (no arrangement is much safer or barer than another).

melee._note: melee.md 'Bots'. lootValue per melee id (fists = the empty melee slot), x levels.botValueMultiplier. A bot picks up a melee weapon (score lootScoreMelee) when its value > current melee value x bots.ai.gunUpgradeFactor. It fights with melee when it has no loaded gun (the M2a fists rule, now with the melee weapon), or when the target is within closeSwitchRange and its held gun's mag is empty. It swings when the target's chest is within range x swingRangeFraction. It chases with melee only within chaseRange, and only an enemy who also has no loaded gun or when no wanted gun is in reach.

rpg._note: rpg.md 'Bots'. The rpg is never picked by the weaponPrefs range-band rule. Each decision tick, a bot carrying the rpg with a rocket (loaded or reserve), engaged on a VISIBLE target at distance in [minRange, maxRange], fires with probability fireChancePerDecision x personality.grenadeChanceMultiplier, at most once per cooldownMs, if (a) a collider lies within coverRadius of the target's feet, or (b) another enemy is within groupRadius of the target, or (c) the target's speed < stillSpeed. Never if the aim ray hits anything within selfSafeDistance. Aim point = target feet + target velocity x flight time x leadFactor + uniform offset within aimErrorMetres (seeded). Swap, ADS, fire, swap back. Out of combat it re-equips and reloads an empty rpg. lootValue: loot comparisons only.

smoke._note: smoke.md 'Bots'. Bots treat live clouds as opaque in every line-of-sight test (segment vs sphere of the current opaque radius), except between points closer than items.smoke.cloud.closeSightRange. Throw (quick, no aim time, at most once per cooldownMs): on entering Retreat with probability retreatThrowChance x personality.smokeChanceMultiplier, at the point throwDistance metres from the bot toward the attacker; while escaping the zone after taking damage in the last recentDamageMs, with probability zoneCrossThrowChance x smokeChanceMultiplier, at the same kind of point. lootScoreSmoke: a smoke stack while below items.smoke.maxCarry.

office._note: M2c office overrides. loot.tiers replace the M2b office overrides key by key (same rationale: more grenades and shotguns, fewer snipers; base grenade weights dropped to make room for smoke). layout.lootUsedPerTier = levels/office.md counts.
